Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Identify the unusual component: among colors with multiple objects, recolor
    # the single-pixel object. Examples show this pixel takes the dominant shape color.
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); groups={}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col=g[r][c]
            if col==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            todo=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); obj=[]
            while todo:
                y,x=todo.pop(); obj.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and g[yy][xx]==col and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); todo.append((yy,xx))
            groups.setdefault(col,[]).append(obj)
    # all colors may have singletons; focus on the one-cell component of the color
    # that also makes a conspicuous main object; it is colored like the dominant motif.
    candidates=[]
    for col,objs in groups.items():
        singles=[o for o in objs if len(o)==1]
        large=[o for o in objs if len(o)>1]
        if singles and large:
            candidates += [(len(large[0]),col,singles[0][0])]
    if candidates:
        _,col,(r,c)=max(candidates)
        # recolor stray to background of main colored component (the target color is 0)
        g[r][c]=0
    return g

    seen=set(); best=[]
    for r in range(h):

            col=g[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); obj=[]
